decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The erection of a single storey rear extension and rear roof extension with a roof window to front of house, as shown on drawings numbered A-01 and A-02, received 15th November 2006, is recommended for approval as the size, position and style of the extensions would not be detrimental to the appearance of the existing building, the amenity of neighbouring properties or would detract from the character of the Conservation Area. The development is therefore in accordance with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), ENV-B.2.2 (Conservation Areas), and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the London Borough of Hounslow UDP, adopted December 2003.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - No demolition or construction work or deliveries shall take place on the site except between the hours of 0800 to 1700 on Mondays to Friday and 0900 to 1300 on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension and rear roof extension with a roof window to front of house
